attempts.name: ataho-aerial-two-hand-smash-south-east

request.subject_description: Same short, stocky orange tiger; brown jacket, cream neck ruff, dark gray pants, bare paws, one tail. Preserve exact original head/body scale, face and pixel-art identity. Keep south-east three-quarter yaw and low top-down view.
request.initial_pose: Compact fighting guard facing south-east. Both fists near chest/cheeks, both feet planted. Original character proportions and same yaw.
request.action_description: ONE jumping TWO-HANDED DOWNWARD HAMMER smash. Start compact fighting guard. Bend knees and jump straight up slightly forward. At apex tuck both knees with feet airborne and clasp BOTH hands TOGETHER ABOVE/BEHIND head. Then hinge torso forward and drive the same joined fist mass DOWN and SCREEN RIGHT as body descends. Land deeply through bent knees while joined fists finish low in front of forward knee, outside body silhouette; briefly hold heavy downward contact, then recover to same guard. Distinct anticipation, fast downward swing, low impact, recovery. No forward punch, no two alternating punches, no elbow, no spin/turn, no weapon, no VFX/shadow/opponent. Keep exact head/body scale, clothes, face direction.

attempts.name: ataho-martial-stomp-south-east

request.subject_description: Same short, stocky orange tiger; brown jacket, cream neck ruff, dark gray pants, bare paws, one tail. Preserve exact original head/body scale, face and pixel-art identity. Keep south-east three-quarter yaw and low top-down view.
request.initial_pose: Compact fighting guard facing south-east. Both fists near chest/cheeks, both feet planted. Original character proportions and same yaw.
request.action_description: ONE short grounded martial STOMP (zhen jiao), then return guard. Keep upper body south-east and both fists near chest/cheeks. Raise ONE forward knee and foot clearly above ground while rear leg supports weight. Drive raised foot STRAIGHT DOWN, sole flat and broad, stamping slightly ahead of rear foot. At contact drop pelvis and bend supporting knee to transmit whole-body weight; torso stays upright/compact, hands stay guard. Brief weighted low contact then return same guard. No kick forward, no hop/two-foot landing, no fullturn,punch, VFX,dust,opponent.

attempts.name: ataho-martial-stomp-south-east-v2

request.action_description: ONE short grounded MARTIAL STOMP in place, then return guard. NOT a forward kick. Lift ONE forward paw only a little by raising its knee; rear paw stays planted. Keep the lifted paw beside the supporting leg, NEVER extending the leg forward. Stamp that paw STRAIGHT VERTICALLY DOWN beside the supporting paw, flat horizontal sole, both paws on the same ground baseline. Sink hips and bend the supporting knee to press whole-body weight into the floor. Upper body remains compact and upright facing SOUTH-EAST throughout, fists always guard near chest/cheeks. Eight-pose flow: guard; small knee lift; raised hold; paw directly DOWN; weighted flat-sole impact; hips compress; settle; guard. NO foot thrust forward, NO kick, NO jumping, NO two-foot landing, NO turning, NO punches. NO white dust, dust clouds, ground rings, light, glowing feet, action lines, shadows, props, opponent or any VFX. Only the same tiger's body on transparency.

observations: 2~3번 작은 발들기,4번 직하 연결,5~6번 접촉으로 전방 킥은 줄었다.
7~8번은 금지한 흰 충격 띠가 있고 손은 가드보다 내려와 있으며 골반 하강이 작다.
7~8번 제외 가능성은 보고했지만 사용자 요청을 완전히 충족했다고 판정하지 않았다.
방향당 최대2시도 상한에 도달해 추가 유료 생성은 하지 않는다.
